name: Mimo-1B
summary: This project provides the necessary scripts and instructions to fine-tune the `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B` model using QLoRA on a macOS system with limited RAM (~8GB), convert it to the GGUF format, and make it ready for use with Ollama and LM Studio.
author: ABDESSEMED Mohamed Redha
